title: harper-lee-finance-legal-personal-todo
content:
Daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal TODOs

Top priorities (this week)
- [ ] Verify Feb vendor invoices: Formstack (INV-2025-02-11) $6,420.00. Check PO match and GL code. Contact Sara (ops) if mismatch.
- [ ] Redline and return NDAs from BetaVendor by 2025-03-05. Focus on: data use clause, indemnity cap, and termination 30-day notice.
- [ ] Renewal reminders: Look at Zendesk subscription renewal (acct ZDX-778) - auto-renew in 30 days. Decide: renew or negotiate discount.
- [ ] Chase outstanding customer credit note for ACME Corp (CN-119) $3,250. Past due 45d. Follow up note + call.

Quick checks / items to triage
- Invoice queue (folder: /Finance/Inboxes) - ~12 new PDFs. Prioritize >$2k or vendors: Formstack, DataSync, Nimbus.
- Payment run schedule: next run 2025-03-06. Need final approvals by 2025-03-04 EOD.
- Expense audit: flagged Uber receipts missing project codes (ask Emily).

Contracts / redlines notes
- BetaVendor NDA: my initial redline saved in Drafts/Contracts. Key changes: 1) Remove broad data sharing clause, 2) Add 1M liability cap, 3) Add 30-day termination for convenience.
  - Questions: do we need to loop Legal Counsel (Ava Chen) for IP carveouts? She mentioned historic rule: avoid carveouts unless product integration.
  - Action: send redline to BetaVendor + cc Legal by 2025-03-03.

Renewals calendar (personal reminders)
- Zendesk (ZDX-778) - auto-renew 2025-04-01. Owner: Harper. Slack: #vendor-renewals.
- Sentry (SNT-210) - contract ends 2025-05-15. Check usage spike last quarter; possible downgrade.
- Cloud storage (Nimbus) - check invoice cadence; consider switch to annual for 10% savings.

Follow-ups / Who to ping
- Sara (ops) - confirm PO for Formstack. Slack DM.
- Priya - confirm whether legal needs to sign NDA as-is or request faster review.
- Jordan - verify GL mapping for last month's vendor accruals.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Can we approve BetaVendor NDA with liability cap at $1M or push for $250k? (Risk tolerance doc link in Confluence)
- For Zendesk renewal, do we want to negotiate enterprise discount or stick with self-serve? (need usage metrics from Product).
- Is it acceptable to process Formstack invoice without PO match if vendor confirms email approval? Need finance manager sign-off.

Notes from Slack & calls
- #finance thread (2025-02-26): account-payable backlog to be cleared by Mar payroll.
- Call w/ BetaVendor (2025-02-28): they requested 7-day turnaround on NDA. Mentioned eagerness to onboard for pilot.

Misc scratchpad (brain dump)
- Add calendar block: Legal review buffer (2 hours) on 2025-03-03.
- Save template: vendor inquiry email (templates/Vendor-PO-query).
- Quick checklist for invoice review: invoice number, vendor name, PO match, GL code, tax id, approval chain, due date.

Tomorrow's quick plan (2025-03-02)
1) Triage invoice inbox (30m)
2) Send NDA redline to BetaVendor (30m)
3) Ping Priya re: Zendesk usage metrics (15m)
4) Add payment approvals for payment run (20m)

Tagging notes to self
- TODO: create a shorter SOP for NDA turnaround times (<72h target). Store under Confluence: FIN-Oper/NDAs.
- FYI: reimbursements processed biweekly - next cutoff 2025-03-07.

End of scratchpad

#notes: informal, may contain shorthand and pending items. Use as working memory only.
